clock: UTC epoch ms and Android elapsedRealtime ms
label_semantics: label_at_receive is only a receive-time snapshot; use labels event timeline for interval annotation
mode: TCP; rate_cap_bps=0 means unlimited, duration_s=0 means until stopped; bidirectional rate cap applies to each direction
sample_semantics: One row per direction per interval; direction explicitly identifies phone_upload or phone_download; sender is the phone role
location_semantics: WGS84; from app 0.4 onward each sample carries the latest valid fix received in the same measurement with no age cutoff; original fix timestamps and location_age_ms are retained; null until a valid fix is received, never filled from another session or a future fix; older records keep their original associations; not interval-wide ground truth
radio_semantics: NR SS-SINR and SS-RSRP are separate from LTE RSSNR and RSRP; serving cell observations are asynchronous and may be stale; radio_age_ms is sample time minus modem timestamp; null means unavailable; Wi-Fi or VPN speed is not attributed to the cellular radio
network_semantics: network_type is the Android default network observed when iperf reported the interval; vpn takes precedence; underlying_hint is not a confirmed VPN route
